name: Crunchy Beef Tacos Supreme® by Taco Bell®

instructions.primary_message: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef (or turkey/chicken) and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until fully browned and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes. Drain excess fat if needed.
Sprinkle the Taco Bell® original seasoning mix over the cooked meat.
Pour in 2/3 cup of water and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer and let it cook for 3-5 minutes, or until the mixture thickens and the flavors meld together.
While the meat mixture simmers, warm your taco shells according to the package instructions (usually in the oven).
Spoon the seasoned meat into each taco shell and add your favorite toppings. Suggestions include shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, sour cream, and your favorite Taco Bell® hot sauce.
Enjoy your Taco Bell® inspired tacos immediately with your favorite side dishes like Mexican rice or refried beans! This recipe is quick, flavorful, and perfect for a taco night!
